title: Inventory and Control of Enterprise Assets
text: Actively manage (enumerate, track, and correct) all enterprise assets connected to the infrastructure, so that only authorized assets are given access, and unauthorized and unmanaged assets are found and prevented from gaining access.

title: Establish and Maintain Detailed Enterprise Asset Inventory
text: Establish and maintain an accurate, detailed, and up-to-date inventory of all enterprise assets with the potential to store or process data, to include: end-user computing devices, including mobile devices; remote devices; non-computing/IoT devices; and servers. Automate modern enterprise assets discovery, create an inventory, and validate and reconcile identified data on a regular basis.

title: Address Unauthorized Assets
text: Process unauthorized assets identified by the automated inventory scanning tool or manual review. Update the enterprise asset inventory with any new assets and remove or disable unauthorized assets.

title: Inventory and Control of Software Assets
text: Actively manage (enumerate, track, and correct) all software on the network so that only authorized software is installed and can execute.

title: Establish and Maintain Detailed Software Inventory
text: Establish and maintain a detailed inventory of all licensed software installed on enterprise assets, including softbots. The inventory must capture, for each softbot: the publisher, the software name, version numbers, deployment status, and end-of-life date.

title: Ensure Authorized Software is Currently Supported
text: Ensure that only currently supported software is designated as authorized in the software inventory for enterprise assets. If software is unsupported, review the enterprise asset's data sensitivity or criticality and remediate accordingly.

title: Data Protection
text: Develop processes and technical controls to identify, classify, securely handle, retain, and dispose of data.

title: Establish and Maintain a Data Management Process
text: Establish and maintain a data management process for enterprise assets. Review and update documentation annually, or when significant enterprise changes occur that could impact this Safeguard.

title: Encrypt Data on Portable Media
text: Encrypt data on portable media devices, such as laptops, cellular devices, or removable media, before leaving enterprise premises. Protect the encryption keys by protecting the removable media.

title: Encrypt Data on Removable Media
text: Encrypt data on removable media devices. Implement this safeguard by using full-disk encryption or file-level encryption on removable media.

title: Secure Configuration of Enterprise Assets and Software
text: Establish and maintain the secure configuration of enterprise assets and software.

title: Establish and Maintain a Secure Configuration Process
text: Establish and maintain a secure configuration process for enterprise assets and software. The process must include establishing and documenting secure configuration standards for all enterprise assets and software.

title: Secure Configuration of Enterprise Assets and Software
text: Establish and maintain the secure configuration of enterprise assets and software. Establish and maintain secure configuration standards for enterprise assets and software, including secure installation and removal.

title: Uninstall or Disable Unnecessary Services
text: Uninstall or disable unnecessary services on enterprise assets and software, such as file-sharing services, web servers, and Bluetooth. Default configurations may enable services that are not needed.

title: Account Management
text: Use processes and tools to assign and manage authorization to credentials for user accounts, including administrator accounts, as well as service accounts.

title: Establish and Maintain an Inventory of Accounts
text: Establish and maintain an inventory of all account types, user, non-user (e.g., service accounts), and system accounts. Inventory all named accounts to ensure each one has a defined purpose.

title: Use Unique Passwords
text: Use unique passwords for all enterprise assets. Best practice recommendations include a password complexity requirement of 14+ characters. Implement centralized password managers where possible.

title: Disable Dormant Accounts
text: Delete or disable dormant accounts after a defined period of inactivity. Identify and remove or disable accounts that are no longer needed for business or technical purposes.

title: Access Control Management
text: Use processes and tools to create, assign, manage, and revoke access credentials and privileges for user, administrator, and service accounts for enterprise assets and software.

title: Establish an Access Granting Process
text: Establish and follow a process for granting access to enterprise assets. Include new account authorization, modification of existing account authorization, and revocation of account authorization.

title: Establish an Access Revoking Process
text: Establish and follow a process for revoking access to enterprise assets, through disabling accounts and/or removing system access when an employee or service account is terminated or upon change of responsibility.

title: Define and Maintain Role-Based Access Control
text: Define and maintain role-based access control, through determining and documenting the access rights necessary for each role within the enterprise to successfully carry out their assigned duties.

title: Continuous Vulnerability Management
text: Develop a plan to continuously assess and track vulnerabilities on all enterprise assets, in order to remediate and minimize the window of opportunity for attackers.

title: Establish a Vulnerability Management Process
text: Establish and maintain a vulnerability management process for enterprise assets. Review and update documentation annually, or when significant enterprise changes occur that could impact this Safeguard.

title: Establish and Maintain a Remediation Process
text: Establish and maintain a risk-based remediation strategy documented in a remediation process, with monthly or more frequent reviews. Include patching, configuration changes, and other remediation actions.

title: Audit Log Management
text: Collect, alert, review, and retain audit logs of events that could help detect, understand, or recover from an attack.

title: Establish and Maintain an Audit Log Management Process
text: Establish and maintain an audit log management process that defines logging requirements. Review and update documentation annually, or when significant enterprise changes occur.

title: Collect Audit Logs
text: Collect audit logs on enterprise assets. Ensure that logging, per the enterprise's log management process, has been enabled across enterprise assets.

title: Email and Web Browser Protections
text: Improve protections and detections of threats from email and web vectors, as these are opportunities for attackers to manipulate human behavior through direct engagement.

title: Ensure Use of Only Fully Supported Browsers and Email Clients
text: Ensure that only fully supported browsers and email clients are allowed to execute in the enterprise, ideally only using the latest version of the browser and email client.

title: Use DNS Filtering Services
text: Use DNS filtering services on all enterprise assets to block access to known malicious domains. Revise access and blocking lists regularly.

title: Malware Defenses
text: Prevent or control the installation, spread, and execution of malicious applications, code, or scripts on enterprise assets.

title: Deploy and Maintain Anti-Malware Software
text: Deploy and maintain anti-malware software on all enterprise assets. Configure automatic updates of anti-malware signature files on all enterprise assets. Ensure that anti-malware scans are configured to scan all data files.

title: Enable Anti-Exploitation Features
text: Enable anti-exploitation features on enterprise assets and software, such as Data Execution Prevention (DEP), Address Space Layout Randomization (ASLR), and exploit protection.
